content:
pagerbot: [PAGER] P1 Alert — auth-proxy-prod: large increase in 401s and anomalous token reuse pattern. approx 4.3k failed token attempts in 5m. Possible credential scraping or replay.
olivia: ACK — olivia oncall (eng-sre). I’m jumping in, pulling proxy and edge logs now.
matt: on it — mfa: looking for source IPs, user-agent noise, and correlated requests to /v1/generate.
security-bot: IOC enrichment: top 3 IPs: 203.0.113.12, 198.51.100.77, 45.76.21.9. Geo: RU, UA. UA header: "mass-fetch/1.2" seen in 82% of spikes.
olivia: quick hypothesis: automated scraping hitting public endpoints with leaked ephemeral tokens. Not seeing obvious S3 pushes yet.
matt: snippet from proxy logs: 
```
203.0.113.12 - "POST /v1/generate" 401 0.23s "mass-fetch/1.2"
198.51.100.77 - "GET /health" 200 0.01s "curl/7.68.0"
```
olivia: mitigation plan (initial): 1) add WAF rule to block UA "mass-fetch/1.2" and top IPs 2) throttle requests from unusual regions 3) rotate any service tokens seen in auth errors 4) start targeted KV log scrub for leaked token fragments
elaine: Elaine (security) joining. I want a conservative approach: block IPs at edge first, then rotate if we see token leakage confirmed. Requesting list of candidate service tokens now.
matt: found repeated token prefix "sk_live_7x9" in some auth debug logs (staging copy). Need to assume possible exposure — prepare rotation.
olivia: executing WAF block now. Applying temporary allowlist for internal monitoring IPs.
security-bot: WAF rule applied: block UA "mass-fetch/1.2", block IPs above. Observability: 90% drop in failed attempts within 60s.
olivia: good reduction. Next: rotate the suspected service key set and trigger cache flush for associated sessions. Run `scripts/rotate-service-key --id svc-analytics-prod` then push keystore sync.
matt: prepping rotation. Copy of command for ops run: 
```bash
./infra/keystore/rotate.sh svc-analytics-prod --invalidate-cache --notify=oncall
```
cs-lina: CS heads up: no confirmed customer-facing outages. Some customers on high-traffic routes may see transient 401s while we rotate keys. I'll draft a short message for affected customers and standby for wording.
elaine: we should also lock down ingestion points and check any outbound logforwarders that might have stale creds. matt please validate logshipper configs.
matt: validating logshipper; found one staging forwarder with archived debug snapshots referencing token fragments. Scheduling a one-off scrub job and remove snapshots.
olivia: for handoff — I need to pass to night oncall in 20m. Action items to handoff ticket: 
- WAF blocks in place (IPs + UA)
- svc-analytics-prod rotated (ticket #INC-9221)
- log snapshots scrubbed from staging buckets (job log: scrub-2026-03-20-001)
- CS message drafted (doc: docs/customer-comm/incident-9221-draft)
- follow-up: audit for KV-cache leak and prompt-store access patterns
elaine: I will own the post-rotate forensics and coordinate with legal if we confirm exfil. Add me to the incident ticket.
cs-lina: draft ready, pinging legal for review. No PII observed in traces so far per quick scan.
olivia: handing off to elaine in 18m. If you find anything that widens scope (S3 or external upload), tag @legal and @product-security immediately.
security-bot: incident created: INC-9221. Severity: P1 -> Elevated mitigation ongoing.
elaine: I’ve taken the bridge. Leaving checklist in incident ticket and adding follow-ups for postmortem: scope, root cause, runbook gaps.
matt: quick note — add a runbook update: auth-proxy should log-token-prefix only to ephemeral storage and mask traces. Creating PR: github.com/redwood/runbooks#update-auth-logging
olivia: thanks team. cs-lina please send customer note when rotation completes.
cs-lina: will send post-rotation summary in 30m.
ellen (oncall-secondary): standing by for any rollback or forensics tasks.
elaine: last message before next: keep retention of affected logs extended for 14 days for forensics. I'll start the evidence collection now.
security-bot: last alert: attempts reduced to baseline. Ongoing: monitoring for 6h.
elle: copy — monitoring and ticket INC-9221 updated with handoff notes.
